---
name: provenance-check
description: Check Ventura Build project briefs references and adapted examples for accurate attribution and license boundaries. Use when an external tutorial repository or specification influences a learning project. Do not use when changing only original CI or repository automation.
---

# Provenance check

- Identify external tutorials repositories specifications or examples influencing the project brief.
- Distinguish inspiration from copied instructions code or assets.
- Read `PROVENANCE.md` when present and keep it aligned.
- Preserve required attribution and license terms for derived material.
- Prefer original project briefs and links when copying is unnecessary.
- Remove unsupported affiliation certification or ownership implications.
